system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Logging sink that exports logs from a project to a BigQuery dataset for long-term analysis.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Logging sink that exports logs from a project to a BigQuery dataset for long-term analysis.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: logging-sink-bigquery-dataset
  type: gcp-types/bigquery-v2:datasets
  properties:
    datasetReference:
      datasetId: logging_sink_dataset
    location: US
    description: "Dataset for storing exported Cloud Logging data"
    defaultTableExpirationMs: 2592000000
    access:
    - role: OWNER
      members:
      - "projectEditor:$(ref.logging-sink-service-account.email)"
    - role: READER
      members:
      - "projectViewer:$(ref.logging-sink-service-account.email)"

- name: logging-sink-service-account
  type: iam.v1.serviceAccount
  properties:
    accountId: logging-sink-sa
    displayName: "Service account for Cloud Logging sink to BigQuery"

- name: logging-sink-bigquery-table
  type: gcp-types/bigquery-v2:tables
  properties:
    datasetId: $(ref.logging-sink-bigquery-dataset.datasetReference.datasetId)
    tableReference:
      tableId: log_entries
    schema:
      fields:
      - name: timestamp
        type: TIMESTAMP
      - name: logName
        type: STRING
      - name: resource
        type: RECORD
        fields:
        - name: type
          type: STRING
        - name: labels
          type: RECORD
          mode: REPEATED
          fields:
          - name: key
            type: STRING
          - name: value
            type: STRING
      - name: severity
        type: STRING
      - name: textPayload
        type: STRING
      - name: jsonPayload
        type: STRING
      - name: protoPayload
        type: STRING
    timePartitioning:
      type: DAY
      expirationMs: 2592000000

- name: logging-sink-project
  type: gcp-types/logging-v2:projects.sinks
  properties:
    sink: logging-sink-to-bigquery
    destination: bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/$(project)/datasets/$(ref.logging-sink-bigquery-dataset.datasetReference.datasetId)
    filter: "resource.type=\"gce_instance\" OR resource.type=\"k8s_container\""
    writerIdentity: $(ref.logging-sink-service-account.email)

- name: logging-sink-set-iam-policy
  type: gcp-types/bigquery-v2:datasets/setIamPolicy
  properties:
    datasetId: $(ref.logging-sink-bigquery-dataset.datasetReference.datasetId)
    policy:
      bindings:
      - role: roles/bigquery.dataEditor
        members:
        - $(ref.logging-sink-project.writerIdentity)
      - role: roles/bigquery.user
        members:
        - "serviceAccount:$(ref.logging-sink-service-account.email)"
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - logging-sink-bigquery-dataset
    - logging-sink-project
    - logging-sink-service-account
